instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures an indoor study room. On the left, the woman in the beige pantsuit (R2) stands upright in profile, smiling warmly. On the right, the man in the blue turtleneck (R1) stands nearly upright, facing her. They are engaged in a firm right-handed handshake over a wooden table in the foreground. The table holds a Scrabble board and several books. The man holds a smartphone in his left hand down by his side. Warm, soft indoor lighting casts gentle shadows, creating a cozy and professional atmosphere.
